checks.explanation: US job openings declined only gradually and remained well above 8-9 million through mid-2023, not falling to the predicted 5-6 million.
The S&P 500 did trade within the predicted roughly 4,000-4,300 range at various points in late 2022 and 2023.
Energy supply and pricing remained a central focus of geopolitical and national-security debate tied to the Ukraine war in that October-November 2022 window.
Inflation remained elevated into early 2023 and the Federal Reserve did continue raising rates beyond that point, matching the conditional prediction.
The Federal Reserve peaked at roughly 5.25-5.5%, well below matching CPI's 9% peak; inflation fell without rates rising to match it one-for-one.
Interest rates and inflation did stay elevated for longer than the pre-2020 era, partially matching the prediction, though the framing as a fully new persistent regime is debatable.

Both specific sub-predictions materialized: US regional-bank/consumer-credit stress emerged in 2023, and Jair Bolsonaro's supporters staged the January 8, 2023 attempted power grab in Brasília after his election loss.
A century-scale prediction that has not yet had time to resolve.
